fields.name: source_name
fields.label: SOURCE NAME
fields.why: The review page shows this beside every row and a reviewer rejects a row whose source does not actually say it. A recipe with no attributable source cannot be reviewed, only believed.

fields.name: source_url
fields.label: SOURCE URL OR LOCATOR
fields.why: Provenance is read-only once a row is written: dashboard.py refuses to let a reviewer re-attribute a recipe. If it is not on the web, give the file path or a locator -- but give something, because nothing is not a locator.

fields.name: licence
fields.label: LICENCE
fields.why: This repo has already had to flag an AGPL corpus and a manual that prohibits redistribution. An unknown licence is a BLOCKER, never a default: establishing it after the rows are embedded into the hints cache is establishing it too late.

fields.name: language
fields.label: LANGUAGE OR AREA
fields.why: domains.recipe_domains() infers a domain tag from this when the rows carry none, and an untagged recipe fails OPEN -- it becomes eligible for every task in the system.

fields.name: domains
fields.label: DOMAINS
fields.why: The fixed vocabulary in domains.DOMAINS. Declared tags are evidence and inferred tags are this repo's guess; the review page draws them differently for that reason. Untagged rows reach every task.
